headline_ur: 4 سال خریدیں، 1 سال مفت حاصل کریں

8.1.en:
New Features:
  • Input tool now supports Arabic and Persian.
  • Quranic surah and verses can now be added using the input tool in Urdu, Arabic and Persian mode.
  • Writing the first two words of a Quran verse also gives the entire verse suggestions.
  • Improved the font change to make it more efficient.
  • Added the writing board tool (Pro Only) for taking notes or writing blogs or articles
  • Added a proofreading tool (Pro Only) for correcting written mistakes for Input tool modes.
  • Added the (About Us) option in the settings menu to connect with our socials
  • Added the (Rate Us) option to help users rate the extension. This will help developer a lot.
8.1.ur: عربی اور فارسی ان پٹ کو ٹھیک کیا، نیا لینگویج پکر شامل کیا، اور X.com پر کئی بگز درست کیے۔
